comments.html: Juniper (oops, HPE) has the cRPD container, which is (apart from a few missing data-plane features) even faster than XRd, and approximately as "easy" to get.
comments.name: Ivan Pepelnjak

comments.html:
Ugh really hope this is just a glitch, but definitely worrying sign of things to come.

I had the pleasure of working with Cisco XRd-control-plane recently. Lightweight container image that works really well. Was a pleasant surprise from previous Cisco virtual offerings. I guess no point hoping Juniper will ever do something similar at this point.
comments.name: Cathal Mooney
